# Security policy

The WP_Query Cheat Sheet is a static site. It has no server, accounts or database of its own.

The playground runs WordPress entirely in your browser through [WordPress Playground](https://wordpress.org/playground/). The PHP you write there runs inside that sandbox on your own device and is never sent to a server run by this project.

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you find a security problem in this site, for example a way for a shared playground link to do something harmful, please report it privately using GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ClearanceClarence-Software/wp-query-cheat-sheet/security/advisories/new) instead of opening a public issue.

Problems in WordPress Playground itself should go to the [WordPress Playground project](https://github.com/WordPress/wordpress-playground/security), and problems in WordPress to the [WordPress security team](https://wordpress.org/about/security/).
